email.subject1: a signal play for Brain Corp
email.body1:
Chris, saw Brain Corp shipped BrainOS Clean 2.0, cleared SOC 2 Type II, and crossed 50,000 deployed robots.

Momentum at that scale usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before the pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Brain Corp off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for Brain Corp.

As the fleet and partner footprint grow, the number usually outpaces the headcount you can add to chase it. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs to hit target, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Brain Corp needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for Brain Corp.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Brain Corp's reply rate likely compares to other robotics and physical-AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Shipping a major platform release is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion as CRO? I will tailor it to Brain Corp either way.
